about_the_game:
In Protect Larry, you are the commander of an army tasked with defending the most important being in the kingdom — your beloved pet duck, Larry! But Larry isn’t just any duck; he possesses magical powers that can save humanity. Evil armies seek to destroy him and it’s up to you to keep him safe.

Lead your troops in massive battles, where you can seamlessly switch between commanding from a top-down tactical view or fighting alongside your soldiers in third-person. The enemy grows stronger and more terrifying with each battle, and it will take all your skills to keep Larry out of harm's way.

As you fight, upgrade your commander and army, unlock new abilities, and choose your path to victory. Will you lead from the front lines or craft the perfect strategy from above? Larry is depending on you, and so is the fate of the world!
